newsitem.title: UK: Europe low sulphur straight-run fuel oil firm.
newsitem.headline: Europe low sulphur straight-run fuel oil firm.

text.p: NWE low sulphur straight-run fuel oil was firm on Thursday but activity was thin, traders said.
North Sea cargoes were offered around $136/$137 fob NWE but buyers differed as to where the bids were - with one regular buyer saying bids would be close to sellers' prices.

Demand into Scandinavia was good, with low hydro electric reservoir levels having prompted Swedish buying of around 300,000 tonnes of very low sulphur Indonesian barrels in the past two weeks. West African low sulphur fuel oil was heard available in Europe on Wednesday at around $145 cif NWE.
